entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: Non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: X3D 4.1
entities.note: Upcoming version of the Extensible 3D Graphics standard, introducing new features like Gaussian Splatting.

entities.name: Khronos Group
entities.note: Consortium responsible for open standards like glTF and WebGL.

entities.name: glTF
entities.note: A royalty-free specification for the efficient transmission and loading of 3D scenes and models.

entities.name: INRIA
entities.note: French national research institute for digital science and technology, where 3DGS was developed.

entities.name: 3D Gaussian Splatting
entities.note: The seminal 2023 research paper introducing real-time radiance field rendering using 3D Gaussians.

entities.name: George Drettakis
entities.note: Senior researcher at INRIA and co-author of the original 3D Gaussian Splatting paper.

entities.name: Bernhard Kerbl
entities.note: Co-author of the 3D Gaussian Splatting paper.

entities.name: GaussianSplats
entities.note: Proposed node in X3D 4.1 for rendering Gaussian Splatting models.

entities.name: KHR_gaussian_splatting
entities.note: Proposed glTF extension for embedding 3D Gaussian Splatting data.

entities.name: SPZ
entities.note: An open-source, highly compressed format for 3D Gaussian Splatting developed by Niantic.

entities.name: Niantic
entities.note: Technology company that developed the SPZ format and Scaniverse.

entities.name: Luma AI
entities.note: Company providing tools for capturing and generating 3D models and splats.

entities.name: PlayCanvas
entities.note: Web-based game engine that supports rendering and editing Gaussian Splats.

entities.name: Three.js
entities.note: Popular JavaScript 3D library that supports rendering glTF and Gaussian Splats via add-ons.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: Open-source framework for integrating X3D into HTML5 DOM, actively implementing splat rendering.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: Cross-platform 3D and 2D game engine supporting X3D and glTF.

entities.name: Model Context Protocol
entities.note: An open standard that enables AI models to securely interact with local tools and data sources.

entities.name: Anthropic
entities.note: AI research company that introduced the Model Context Protocol.

entities.name: Blender
entities.note: Open-source 3D creation suite.

entities.name: Blender MCP
entities.note: An MCP server implementation allowing LLMs to interact with and control Blender.

entities.name: X3D MCP
entities.note: An MCP server implementation for generating and manipulating X3D scenes via LLMs.

entities.name: Shap-E
entities.note: OpenAI's conditional generative model for 3D assets.

entities.name: Point-E
entities.note: OpenAI's system for generating 3D point clouds from complex prompts.

entities.name: OpenAI
entities.note: AI research organization that developed Shap-E and Point-E.

entities.name: Tripo3D
entities.note: AI-powered tool for fast text-to-3D and image-to-3D generation.

entities.name: CSM
entities.note: Common Sense Machines, providing AI pipelines for 3D asset generation.

entities.name: Meshy
entities.note: AI toolkit for generating 3D models from text and images.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: Co-chair of the Web3D Consortium and key architect of X3D.

entities.name: Andreas Plesch
entities.note: Key contributor to X3DOM and Web3D standards.

entities.name: Michalis Kamburelis
entities.note: Lead developer of the Castle Game Engine and active Web3D community member.

entities.name: Web3D 2024
entities.note: The 29th International Conference on 3D Web Technology.

entities.name: SIGGRAPH 2023
entities.note: Major computer graphics conference where 3D Gaussian Splatting was presented.

entities.name: PLY
entities.note: Polygon File Format, commonly used to store raw 3D Gaussian Splatting data.

entities.name: SuperSplat
entities.note: Open-source Gaussian Splat editor developed by PlayCanvas.
